review_scope: expected verdicts and checked declaration identities
method: A separate agent re-derived the expectations from the raw syntax, typing rules and pinned source paths without using prior checker agreement as semantic authority.
independence_limit: This review is independently derived but corroborative, not blinded. Mandatory RESEARCH_STATUS and the retained cases/input reviews disclose prior outcomes or expected fields, and a broad source search surfaced two prior outcome snippets before the review scope was tightened.

pairing_review.expression: Each pair changes one application argument reference from S0 to S1 and covers value, declared-type and binder-domain placement.
pairing_review.pi: Each pair replaces codomain S1 with the same closed term F and covers declared-type and value placement; decoded trees, not NDJSON line counts, define the mutation.
pairing_review.identity_requirement: Family-qualified case ID, input hash, decoded type/value tree and declaration name are all required because both families contain B-control/B-negative names and pair members share declaration names.

consumer_contract.use: bounded manual smoke test for omitted application-argument checking and Pi-codomain sort checking during checker profile upgrades

required_classification_controls: Missing cells, empty output, parser failures, timeouts, unrelated panics and absent checked identity are unresolved rather than semantic rejection.
Nanoda rejection requires the pinned domain-comparison or infer_sort_of site, not a generic panic.
Control acceptance requires one-declaration input plus complete checking and the expected declaration identity.
Changed profiles require fresh source/runtime/configuration identities and do not inherit this result.
